name: The Crown of Will
summary: With Mug'Thol's lieutenants dead, Melisara in Tarren Mill sends you after him. Bring back his head and the Crown of Will, and the Crushridge resistance will be over.

sections.title: The Last Head
sections.body: Only Mug'Thol remains. Melisara expects him to resist giving up the Crown of Will. After his lieutenants fell, he likely expects you. Find him, kill him, and bring his head and the Crown back to Tarren Mill.

sections.title: Melisara's Reply
sections.body: Melisara is pleased with your work. Mug'Thol's head will adorn the highest peak of the Ruins of Alterac, and the Deathguard will crush what remains of the Crushridge.

faq.q: Who sends you to kill Mug'Thol?
aliases: who gives the crown of will
faq.answer: Melisara in Tarren Mill sends you to kill Mug'Thol, and you bring his head back to her.

faq.q: What does Melisara require from Mug'Thol?
aliases: what do i get from mugthol
faq.answer: Melisara requires Mug'Thol's head and the Crown of Will.

faq.q: Why does Melisara think Mug'Thol expects trouble?
faq.answer: With his lieutenants dead, Melisara suspects Mug'Thol expects you and will resist giving up the Crown.

faq.q: Where does this fall in The Crown of Will?
aliases: what quest comes before crown of will 4
faq.answer: This comes after the third part, in which Mug'Thol's lieutenants were hunted, and is followed by a fifth part.
